name: How do I choose a reliable plumber or electrician in the Berkeley area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable plumber or electrician in the Berkeley area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a plumber or electrician in Berkeley, look for licensed and insured professionals with a good reputation. Ask for references and check online reviews. Consider their experience with the specific type of work you need done. Obtain multiple quotes to compare services and pricing. Ensure they provide a clear scope of work and warranty information.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured professional with good reviews, relevant experience, and clear pricing in Berkeley.
